name: The West Hollywood EDITION
positioning: Ian Schrager-designed EDITION hotel on West Sunset Boulevard, where West Hollywood meets Beverly Hills
best_for: Travelers who want a Sunset Boulevard base with a rooftop pool and on-site nightlife
Guests who enjoy a cocktail bar, a nightclub and a spa without leaving the hotel

facts.text: The hotel is on the corner of West Sunset Boulevard and North Doheny Drive, where West Hollywood meets Beverly Hills.
The rooms feature modern decor and detailing by Ian Schrager.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Los Angeles or the Hollywood Hills.
Suites have separate living and sleeping areas, and many offer private step-out balconies with city views.
The two penthouses have expansive outdoor terraces.
Ardor, the signature restaurant, serves vegetable-forward healthy California cuisine with flavors inspired by local ingredients.
Each dish at Ardor is made with organic ingredients.
The Roof is a terraced rooftop deck with wooden bench seating, mature trees and potted plants.
Lobby Bar serves bespoke cocktails and is a gathering place for both hotel guests and West Hollywood locals.
The 24-hour fitness center is complimentary to guests.
Guest services include twice-daily housekeeping, concierge service, valet parking and complimentary high-speed wireless internet.
The hotel offers over 6,500 square feet of meeting and event space.

highlights.text: Sunset is a nightclub inspired by the clubs of the Sunset Strip in the 1960s and 70s.
The pool sits on the rooftop above Sunset Boulevard with views of the Hollywood Hills, Beverly Hills and the Los Angeles skyline.
The Roof's cocktail menu is Latin and tropical-inspired with Southern California flair, with a deep list of mezcals and tequilas.
The spa offers technology-forward treatments with sound and light, recovery therapies, and self-guided meditation.
The spa's inner health and nutrition focus includes plant-derived products such as essential oils.

considerations.text: The Sunset nightclub has a separate entrance from the hotel, on North Doheny Drive.
The spa requires appointments to be cancelled at least 24 hours in advance to avoid being charged the full amount.
WhataHotel notes limited parking availability in the busy West Hollywood area.
